title: Translation of the Physical Activity Questionnaire for Older Children into the German language, transcultural adaptation and validation
summary: In the PAQ-C-GER study, the German-language Physical Activity Questionnaire for Older Children will be validated in a target group of children aged 8 to 14 years. For this purprose, in addition to the German-language PAQ-C-GER, similar questionnaires such as the Physical Activity Enjoyment Scale (PACES), the Scale for Self-Efficacy for Physical Activity (SSA Scale) and the Kidscreen-10: Fragebogen zur Erfassung der gesundheitsbezogenen Lebensqualität von Kindern und Jugendlichen are collected to check the convergent validity between the to evaluate test instruments. This process is repeated after two weeks, if possible on the same children.
conditions: The object of investigation is the German-language version of the Physical Activity Questionnaires for Older Children. Here quality criteria of validity are examined by means of strongly converging questionnaires by a random sample of healthy volunteers aged 8 to 14.

interventions.name: Validation of the German-language Physical Activity Questionnaire for Older Children (PAQ-C-GER) in the target population

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Only healthy children aged 8 to 14 years will be included in the study, with no known acute, chronic, neurological, or mental health conditions, and whose legal guardians have provided written consent for participation.
Exclusion criteria:
Children with relevant acute, chronic, neurological, mental health, or developmental conditions will be excluded, as will children who rely on mobility aids such as wheelchairs or walkers. Children who are cognitively unable to understand the questionnaires, or for whom written parental/legal guardian consent or child assent is not provided, will also be excluded.
